title: Katana (X4: Foundations)
intro: The Katana is a medium Terran corvette added around the Cradle of Humanity expansion. It uses the shared X4 flight controls; JoyPro has not checked its weapons.

panels.name: Katana: seat and weapons
panels.text: Facts about the Katana that set it apart from other X4 ships: where the pilot sits and which guns, turrets and docking it has.
panels.context: All other controls of the Katana are the shared X4 controls of this guide.

controls.name: Pilot seat
controls.text: The Katana is flown from a cockpit seat, as small and medium ships are. The pilot sits here and has all the controls of this guide.
controls.context: From this seat the pilot sees the HUD, the radar and the monitors of the Katana.

controls.name: Ship class
controls.text: X4 sorts ships by size: S (small), M (medium), L (large) and XL (extra large). The Katana is: Terran M-class corvette; armament not checked.
controls.context: The size decides whether the ship is flown from a cockpit or a bridge and where it can dock.
